# Marketing Studio Image API

> Generate and edit campaign images, with optional preset-based prompt enhancement.

Generate and edit campaign images, with optional preset-based prompt enhancement.

| Workflow | Endpoint |
| - | - |
| [2.0 Alpha](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/marketing-studio-image/generate-and-edit.md) | `POST /marketing-studio/image` |
| [2.5 Flare](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/marketing-studio-image/flare.md) | `POST /marketing-studio/image/flare` |
